components.name: Icon
components.doc: A GPUI Kit icon (the Lucide set).

props.name: name
props.doc: Icon name, such as search or arrow-right.

props.name: size
props.doc: Icon size. Defaults to md; className text colors tint it.

props.name: svg
props.doc: Inline SVG markup to draw instead of a named icon.

components.name: Animate
components.doc: Animates its children when they appear, or continuously with repeat.

props.name: repeat
props.doc: Restarts the animation after it finishes.

props.name: key
props.doc: Changing the key replays the animation.

components.name: Badge
components.doc: Shows a count or dot over its children, such as an unread total on an icon or label.

props.name: count
props.doc: Number shown on the badge. Zero hides the count.

props.name: max
props.doc: Largest count shown; larger counts read as max+.

props.name: dot
props.doc: Shows a small dot instead of a count.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Shows an icon instead of a count or dot.

props.name: color
props.doc: Badge color. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

components.name: Tag
components.doc: A small labelled tag for status or category.

props.name: outline
props.doc: Draws an outline instead of a filled tag.

props.name: palette
props.doc: A named Tailwind color family for the tag.

props.name: color
props.doc: Custom fill; set foreground and borderColor too. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

components.name: Label
components.doc: A text label with optional secondary text.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Muted text shown after the label.

props.name: masked
props.doc: Draws the text as bullets, as for a password.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Text to highlight inside the label, such as a search match.

props.name: highlightPrefix
props.doc: Highlights only a match at the start of the label.

components.name: Kbd
components.doc: Renders a keyboard shortcut as key caps.

props.name: keys
props.doc: Keystroke such as cmd-k or ctrl-shift-p. Invalid keystrokes throw.

props.name: command
props.doc: Shows the keys bound to this Shortcut command instead of keys.

props.name: plain
props.doc: Draws the keys without the key-cap styling.

components.name: Separator
components.doc: A horizontal or vertical divider, optionally labelled.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text shown in the middle of the line.

props.name: color
props.doc: Line color. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

components.name: Skeleton
components.doc: A loading placeholder block. Size it with className.

components.name: Spinner
components.doc: An animated loading indicator.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon to spin. Defaults to a loader.

props.name: color
props.doc: Spinner color. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

components.name: Progress
components.doc: A horizontal progress bar.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows an indeterminate animation instead of the value.

props.name: color
props.doc: Bar color. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.doc: A circular progress indicator.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows an indeterminate animation instead of the value.

props.name: color
props.doc: Bar color. A theme color name (such as primary, red or magenta) or #rrggbb.

components.name: Avatar
components.doc: A user avatar: an image, or initials from the name.

props.name: name
props.doc: Person's name; its initials show when there is no image.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Icon shown when there is no image or name.

components.name: Alert
components.doc: A callout message with a variant color and optional title.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look and icon. Defaults to info.

props.name: banner
props.doc: Full-width banner layout without rounded corners.

props.name: visible
props.doc: False hides the alert. Defaults to true.

events.doc: Shows a close button; called when it is clicked.

components.name: ShimmerText
components.doc: Text with an animated shimmer, for pending or generated content.

props.name: highlightColor
props.doc: Highlight color: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

props.name: spread
props.doc: Highlight half-width as a fraction of the text width.

components.name: Empty
components.doc: An empty-state panel with a title, description and optional actions as children.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon in a muted frame above the title.

components.example: <Empty title="No projects" description="Create one to get started."/>

components.name: GroupBox
components.doc: A titled, bordered group of related content.

props.name: contentClassName
props.doc: Utility classes for the content surface.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.doc: Label and value pairs in a grid. Children are DescriptionItem elements.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Puts each label above its value.

components.name: DescriptionItem
components.doc: One label and value inside a DescriptionList.

props.name: span
props.doc: Number of columns the item spans. Defaults to 1.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.doc: A navigation trail. Children are BreadcrumbItem elements.

components.name: BreadcrumbItem
components.doc: One entry in a Breadcrumb.

events.doc: Called when the entry is clicked.

components.name: Clipboard
components.doc: A copy-to-clipboard icon button.

events.doc: Receives the copied text.

components.name: Checkbox
components.doc: A checkbox with an optional label. Pair checked with onChange to control it.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

events.doc: Receives the requested checked state after a click.

components.name: Switch
components.doc: An on/off switch with an optional label. Pair checked with onChange to control it.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

props.name: color
props.doc: Track color when on: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

events.doc: Receives the requested state after a click.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.doc: A single-choice group. Children are Radio elements; selection is by index.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Index of the selected Radio, or -1 for none.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks options vertically. Defaults to horizontal.

events.doc: Receives the clicked option's index.

components.name: Radio
components.doc: One option in a RadioGroup; also usable standalone with checked and onChange.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Selected state of a standalone radio. Inside a RadioGroup, the group's selected index wins.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

events.doc: Receives true when a standalone radio is chosen.

components.name: Toggle
components.doc: A button that stays pressed while on. Use a label, an icon or both.

events.doc: Receives the new pressed state.

components.name: Rating
components.doc: A star rating input.

props.name: color
props.doc: Star color: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

events.doc: Receives the clicked star count.

components.name: Pagination
components.doc: Page navigation buttons. Pages are numbered from 1.

props.name: compact
props.doc: Shows only previous and next buttons.

events.doc: Receives the requested page.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A draggable numeric slider.

events.doc: Receives the new value while dragging.

components.name: Stepper
components.doc: Progress through numbered steps. Children are StepperItem elements.

components.name: StepperItem
components.doc: One step in a Stepper.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: A tab bar. Children are Tab elements; show the matching panel yourself from the selected index.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual style. Defaults to the standard tab style.

events.doc: Receives the clicked tab's index.

components.name: Tab
components.doc: One tab in Tabs.

components.name: Accordion
components.doc: Collapsible sections. Children are AccordionItem elements; each item's own children are its content.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Allows several sections open at once.

props.name: bordered
props.doc: Draws borders around sections. Defaults to true.

events.doc: Receives the open item indexes as comma-separated text, such as "0,2".

components.name: AccordionItem
components.doc: One section of an Accordion; its children are the section content.

components.name: Collapsible
components.doc: Shows its children only while open.

components.name: Select
components.doc: A dropdown that picks one string from a list.

props.name: value
props.doc: Selected option. An empty string selects nothing.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text shown when nothing is selected.

events.doc: Receives the chosen option.

components.name: NumberInput
components.doc: A numeric text field with increment and decrement buttons.

props.name: step
props.doc: Change per button press. Defaults to 1.

events.doc: Receives each valid edited value.

components.name: OtpInput
components.doc: A one-time code field with one box per character.

events.doc: Receives the code as it is typed.

components.name: DatePicker
components.doc: A date field with a calendar dropdown. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD text.

props.name: value
props.doc: Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty for none.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text shown when no date is selected.

events.doc: Receives the chosen date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty when cleared.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.doc: A color swatch with a picker popover. Colors are #rrggbb text.

events.doc: Receives the chosen color as #rrggbb.

components.name: Tooltip
components.doc: Shows text when the pointer rests on its children.

components.name: Popover
components.doc: A floating panel opened by clicking its trigger. Children are one PopoverTrigger and one PopoverContent.

components.name: PopoverTrigger
components.doc: The element that opens a Popover.

components.name: PopoverContent
components.doc: The floating content of a Popover.

components.name: HoverCard
components.doc: A floating card shown while the pointer rests on its trigger.

components.name: HoverCardTrigger
components.doc: The element that shows a HoverCard.

components.name: HoverCardContent
components.doc: The content of a HoverCard.

components.name: Dialog
components.doc: A modal dialog shown while open is true. Its children are the dialog body.

props.name: open
props.doc: Opens the dialog when true and closes it when false.

props.name: okText
props.doc: Shows an OK button with this text.

props.name: cancelText
props.doc: Shows a Cancel button with this text.

events.doc: Called when the user dismisses the dialog; set open to false here.
Called when the OK button is clicked.

components.example: <Dialog open={editing.get()} title="Rename" okText="Save" onClose={() => { editing.set(false); }}><Input value={name}/></Dialog>

components.name: Sheet
components.doc: A panel that slides in from the window edge while open is true.

props.name: open
props.doc: Shows the sheet when true and hides it when false.

events.doc: Called when the user dismisses the sheet; set open to false here.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.doc: A button that opens a menu of MenuItem, MenuLabel, MenuSeparator and Submenu children. A Button child, if present, is the trigger with all its options.

props.name: label
props.doc: Trigger text when no Button child is given.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Point of the menu aligned to the trigger. Defaults to top-left.

props.name: menuLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers for the menu toggle.

props.name: color
props.doc: Custom trigger fill: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

props.name: maxHeight
props.doc: Maximum menu height in pixels; taller menus scroll.

props.name: checkSide
props.doc: Side the check mark of checked items is drawn on. Defaults to left.

props.name: externalLinkIcon
props.doc: Shows an external-link icon on link items. Defaults to true.

components.name: MenuItem
components.doc: One menu entry. Children, if any, replace the label as custom content.

props.name: command
props.doc: A Shortcut command: the entry shows its keys and choosing it runs the command.

props.name: href
props.doc: Opens this URL in the browser when chosen.

events.doc: Called when the entry is chosen.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.doc: Shows a menu of MenuItem, MenuLabel, MenuSeparator and Submenu children on right-click over its other children.

props.name: maxHeight
props.doc: Maximum menu height in pixels; taller menus scroll.

props.name: checkSide
props.doc: Side the check mark of checked items is drawn on. Defaults to left.

props.name: externalLinkIcon
props.doc: Shows an external-link icon on link items. Defaults to true.

components.name: Sidebar
components.doc: An application sidebar. Children are SidebarGroup elements.

components.name: SidebarGroup
components.doc: A labelled group of SidebarItem entries.

components.name: SidebarItem
components.doc: One navigation entry in a SidebarGroup.

events.doc: Called when the entry is clicked.

components.name: Resizable
components.doc: Panels separated by draggable handles. Children are ResizablePanel elements.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks panels vertically. Defaults to side by side.

components.name: ResizablePanel
components.doc: One panel in a Resizable layout.

props.name: size
props.doc: Initial size in pixels. Omit to share the remaining space.

components.name: Table
components.doc: A static table. Children are TableHeader and TableBody, which contain TableRow elements.

components.name: TableHeader
components.doc: The header rows of a Table.

components.name: TableBody
components.doc: The body rows of a Table.

components.name: TableRow
components.doc: One row of a Table.

components.name: TableHead
components.doc: A header cell.

components.name: TableCell
components.doc: A body cell.

components.name: Markdown
components.doc: Renders Markdown: headings, lists, emphasis, links, code blocks and tables.

props.name: scrollable
props.doc: Scrolls when taller than its space.

components.name: Html
components.doc: Renders a safe subset of HTML as styled text (no scripts or browser behavior).

components.name: Image
components.doc: Shows an image from a file path, asset path or https URL, with a fallback while loading or on failure.

props.name: fit
props.doc: How the image fills its box. Defaults to contain.

props.name: alt
props.doc: Text shown while loading or when the image cannot be loaded.

components.name: TitleBar
components.doc: A custom window title bar holding its children. Use it with the custom titlebar window option.

components.name: StatusBar
components.doc: A bottom status bar. StatusBarLeft and StatusBarRight hold edge content; other children sit in the middle.

components.name: StatusBarLeft
components.doc: Left-aligned content of a StatusBar.

components.name: StatusBarRight
components.doc: Right-aligned content of a StatusBar.

components.name: Toolbar
components.doc: A horizontal toolbar of buttons and other controls.

components.name: Form
components.doc: Lays out Field elements with aligned labels, in one or more columns.

props.name: horizontal
props.doc: Puts labels beside their fields instead of above.

components.name: Field
components.doc: One labelled field in a Form; its children are the control.
components.example: <Field label="Email" description="We never share it."><Input value={email}/></Field>

components.name: ScrollArea
components.doc: Scrolls its children vertically (or horizontally) with GPUI Kit scrollbars.

components.name: Message
components.doc: A chat message: avatar, author and time header, and a bubble holding its children.

props.name: author
props.doc: Sender name; its initials make the avatar.

props.name: align
props.doc: start for received messages, end for sent ones. Defaults to start.

components.name: Chart
components.doc: A line, bar, area, pie, radar, candlestick or sankey chart of labelled values.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Chart type. Defaults to line. candlestick reads open/high/low/close; sankey reads labels as nodes and links as flows.

props.name: values
props.doc: Data values, in label order (line, bar, area, pie and radar).

props.name: open
props.doc: Candlestick opening values, in label order.

props.name: close
props.doc: Candlestick closing values, in label order.

props.name: links
props.doc: Sankey flows as [source label, target label, value] triples.

components.name: List
components.doc: A virtualized list of text rows that stays fast with thousands of items.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Index of the highlighted row, or -1 for none.

events.doc: Receives the clicked row's index.

components.name: Tree
components.doc: A collapsible tree. Children are TreeItem elements, which can nest.
components.example: <Tree onSelect={(id) => { open(id); }}><TreeItem id="src" label="src" expanded={true}><TreeItem id="src/main.tsr" label="main.tsr"/></TreeItem></Tree>

events.doc: Receives the clicked item's id.

components.name: TreeItem
components.doc: One node in a Tree; nested TreeItem children are its sub-items.

props.name: expanded
props.doc: Starts expanded when it has children.

components.name: Calendar
components.doc: An inline month calendar. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD text.

props.name: value
props.doc: Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty for none.

props.name: months
props.doc: Months shown side by side. Defaults to 1.

events.doc: Receives the chosen date as YYYY-MM-DD.

components.name: TimeField
components.doc: A segmented time-of-day field. Times are HH:MM or HH:MM:SS text (24-hour).

events.doc: Receives the edited time as HH:MM:SS, or empty when cleared.

components.name: Combobox
components.doc: A searchable dropdown that picks one string from a list.

props.name: value
props.doc: Selected option, or empty for none.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text shown when nothing is selected.

events.doc: Receives the chosen option.

components.name: Command
components.doc: A command palette: a search field over CommandItem entries.
components.example: <Command placeholder="Type a command…"><CommandItem label="New file" onSelect={() => { create(); }}/></Command>

components.name: CommandItem
components.doc: One entry in a Command palette.

props.name: label
props.doc: Entry text; the palette filters on it.

events.doc: Called when the entry is chosen with Enter or a click.

components.name: Carousel
components.doc: Shows one CarouselSlide at a time with previous and next buttons.

props.name: loop
props.doc: Wraps from the last slide to the first.

events.doc: Receives the shown slide's index after navigation.

components.name: CarouselSlide
components.doc: One slide of a Carousel.

components.name: CodeEditor
components.doc: A source-code editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers and folding.

props.name: language
props.doc: Language for highlighting and editing rules, such as rust, typescript or json.

events.doc: Receives the full text after each edit.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.doc: A set of Toggle buttons shown as one control.

props.name: segmented
props.doc: Draws the toggles as one segmented control.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.doc: Buttons joined into one control. Children are Button elements (with all their options) or GroupButton shorthands; a selected child shows as pressed.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Lets several buttons be selected; onClick then reports every selected index.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look applied to every button in the group.

props.name: color
props.doc: Custom variant fill: a theme color name (such as magenta) or #rrggbb.

events.doc: Receives the selected button indexes after a click, comma-separated (such as 0,2).

components.name: GroupButton
components.doc: One button in a ButtonGroup.

events.doc: Called when the button is clicked.

components.name: InputGroup
components.doc: A text field framed together with an icon, leading and trailing text, and an optional action button.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Text before the field, such as https://.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: Text after the field, such as .com.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.doc: Label of a trailing button; no button when omitted.

events.doc: Receives the text after each edit.
Called when the trailing button is clicked.

components.example: <InputGroup icon="search" placeholder="Search" buttonLabel="Go" value={query.get()} onChange={(text) => { query.set(clone(text)); }} onButton={() => { search(); }}/>

components.name: Diff
components.doc: A read-only view of a unified or Git patch, with one section per changed file.

props.name: patch
props.doc: Unified diff text, as printed by git diff.

props.name: mode
props.doc: One column, or old and new side by side. Defaults to unified.

components.name: Marker
components.doc: A status row: an icon and text, optionally drawn as a separator line or bordered note, with a loading spinner.

props.name: variant
props.doc: plain, separator (lines on both sides) or border. Defaults to plain.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner instead of the icon.

components.name: Attachment
components.doc: One file or media item with a title, description, upload status and remove/retry controls.

props.name: description
props.doc: Secondary text, such as PDF · 2.4 MB.

props.name: image
props.doc: Path of a local image used as the preview.

events.doc: Called when the attachment is clicked.
Shows a remove button; called when it is clicked.
Shows a retry button on failure; called when it is clicked.

components.example: <Attachment title="report.pdf" description="PDF · 2.4 MB" icon="file-text" onRemove={() => { remove(); }}/>

components.name: AttachmentGroup
components.doc: A horizontally scrolling row of Attachment elements.

components.name: DataTable
components.doc: A virtualized table of text rows with sortable, resizable columns and row selection.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Rows of cell text, in column order.

props.name: sortable
props.doc: Lets the user sort by clicking a heading. Numbers sort numerically.

events.doc: Receives the selected row's index in rows.

components.example: <DataTable columns={['Name', 'Age']} rows={[['Ada', '36'], ['Alan', '41']]} sortable={true} onSelect={(row) => { picked.set(row); }} className="h-64"/>

components.name: Settings
components.doc: A searchable settings window: a sidebar of SettingsPage entries, each with grouped SettingItem rows.
components.example: <Settings className="h-96"><SettingsPage title="General"><SettingsGroup title="Appearance"><SettingItem title="Dark mode"><Switch checked={dark.get()} onChange={(on) => { dark.set(on); }}/></SettingItem></SettingsGroup></SettingsPage></Settings>

components.name: SettingsPage
components.doc: One page in Settings, listed in its sidebar.

components.name: SettingsGroup
components.doc: A titled box of SettingItem rows in a SettingsPage.

components.name: SettingItem
components.doc: One setting: a title and description beside its control (the children).

components.name: MessageScroller
components.doc: A chat transcript that follows new messages at the bottom, keeps its place while reading history, and offers a jump-to-latest button.

props.name: jumpLabel
props.doc: Text of the jump-to-latest button. Defaults to Jump to latest.

components.name: Dock
components.doc: A workspace of DockPanel elements in resizable splits; users drag tabs to rearrange, stack and split panels.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks the panels top to bottom instead of side by side.

components.name: DockPanel
components.doc: One tabbed panel in a Dock; its children are the panel content.

props.name: size
props.doc: Initial width (or height when vertical) in pixels; omitted panels share the remaining space.

components.name: Questionnaire
components.doc: A step-by-step survey of Question elements with progress, Back/Skip/Next/Submit and required-answer validation. Choosing an answer moves to the next question.

events.doc: Receives the answers as JSON: an object from question id to the array of chosen choice ids.

components.example: <Questionnaire onSubmit={(answers) => { saved.set(clone(answers)); }}><Question id="plan" title="Which plan?" required={true}><QuestionChoice id="free" label="Free"/><QuestionChoice id="pro" label="Pro"/></Question></Questionnaire>

components.name: Question
components.doc: One question in a Questionnaire; its QuestionChoice children are the answers.

props.name: id
props.doc: Key of this question in the submitted answers.

components.name: QuestionChoice
components.doc: One answer to a Question.

components.name: SpeechButton
components.doc: A microphone button that dictates with the system speech recognizer (macOS and Windows). Click to start; click again to stop and receive the final transcript.

props.name: locale
props.doc: BCP 47 language such as en-US or fr-FR. Defaults to the system language.

props.name: waveform
props.doc: Shows the input level beside the button while listening.

events.doc: Receives the whole transcript so far while the user speaks.
Receives the final transcript when the session ends; it may be empty.
Receives a readable message when recognition fails, such as denied microphone access.

components.name: Plot
components.doc: A custom chart over shared category labels: layer PlotLine, PlotArea and PlotBars marks on one value scale, with optional axis labels and grid.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Category labels along the x axis, one per value.

props.name: axis
props.doc: Draws the x axis with labels. Defaults to false.

props.name: grid
props.doc: Draws dashed horizontal grid lines. Defaults to false.

components.example: <Plot labels={['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4']} axis={true} grid={true} className="h-64"><PlotBars values={[4, 6, 5, 8]}/><PlotLine values={[3, 5, 6, 7]} curve="linear" dots={true}/></Plot>

components.name: PlotLine
components.doc: A line through one value per Plot label.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color (chart-1 … chart-5, primary, destructive, foreground, muted-foreground) or #rrggbb. Defaults to the next chart color.

props.name: dots
props.doc: Marks each point with a dot.

props.name: width
props.doc: Stroke width in pixels. Defaults to 2.

components.name: PlotArea
components.doc: A filled area from the baseline up to one value per Plot label.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color (chart-1 … chart-5, primary, destructive, foreground, muted-foreground) or #rrggbb. Defaults to the next chart color.

components.name: PlotBars
components.doc: Vertical bars, one per Plot label; several PlotBars sit side by side.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color (chart-1 … chart-5, primary, destructive, foreground, muted-foreground) or #rrggbb. Defaults to the next chart color.

components.name: Shortcut
components.doc: Binds a keyboard shortcut to a named command while it is mounted. Buttons, menu items and key hints that name the same command show this shortcut.

props.name: command
props.doc: Command name, such as save; also named by Button tooltipCommand and menu items.

props.name: keys
props.doc: Keystrokes in GPUI notation, such as cmd-s, ctrl-shift-p or alt-enter; secondary-s means cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere.

events.doc: Called when the keys are pressed.

components.name: MenuLabel
components.doc: A non-interactive heading inside a menu.

components.name: MenuSeparator
components.doc: A divider between menu entries.

components.name: Submenu
components.doc: A nested menu opened from its parent menu.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.doc: Overlapping avatars; avatars past the limit are hidden or summarized by an ellipsis.

props.name: ellipsis
props.doc: Shows an ellipsis avatar when some avatars are hidden by the limit.

components.name: EmptyMedia
components.doc: Custom media (an image, avatar or avatar group) above an Empty state's title.

props.name: framed
props.doc: Draws the media in a muted icon frame.

components.name: GroupBoxFooter
components.doc: Content placed below a GroupBox's surface.

Button.label: children
